entry_state: Chapter 11 closes by separating retained option rights, their associated liabilities and asset measurement bases. Funding capacity, draw request, confirmed settlement and an uncertain acknowledgement remain distinct. Bank behavior and regulatory assessment need their own facts and evidence; the next chapter examines insurance service, finance and claims.
exit_state: Insurance premium, service revenue and profit follow different schedules. Group measurement retains future service, incurred claims, risk adjustment and unearned profit separately. The two-year cases distinguish loss reversal from revenue and finance from service; the connected issued groups and reinsurance reconcile through year one, while year-two settlement is still being developed.
findings: The cash and component schedules expose double counting that a final liability total would conceal.
The chain-ladder illustration preserves missing variance evidence; the supplied risk adjustments and rates remain assumptions.
The connected group allocation includes finance in the loss component and retains the reinsurance asset separately. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
